fields.statement: At 6addeb28 (detached checkout, RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset): go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-notes|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes; change-notes.txtar runs note add on a node, on a change set, and on a change set with --op, each followed by fold-ok, render and rhiza check, plus the unknown-target and foreign --op failures. make check exits 0 (self-check clean, so the attempt-1 render finding is fixed). By hand in a scratch repo with every RHIZA_* var unset: note add on a capability wrote one entry (a note node and a link) and exited 0; note add nonesuch exited 2 ('no node or change set'); --op 01ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ on the change set exited 2 ('is not an operation of change set'); render then rhiza check printed ok.
